reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000579 (the melody read from 000579a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Herbert B. Turner's dates are uncertain, so the page says only that they lived in the 18th century; they died by 1800 (our page for Christ Returneth (content/hymns/christ-returneth.json)). CCEH's page gives only the year 1907. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000579a.nwc).
